description: List your workspace's outbound webhook endpoints: each one's id, url, events, status and signing secret (whsec_...; the secret is how you verify the x-lastprice-signature header on what it receives). Needs the owner or admin role, and a key with no scope limits or a person's sign-in. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_webhooks
